Spatial prediction
Civic ascent occupies the +6 Chapel porch before climbing
the separate edge flight and circling Chapel. The Press
house exits into A’s southern street. Upper bridge
arrivals reach the other side of West Homes. These are
different clearing sequences, not two identical stair
mouths.
Support / opposing response
O01 gives conditional crouch preparation; flanks remain.
The bridge stance cannot fire through M08 to assist the
southern street. A CT two-front retake requires a survivor
already on west middle or time for that transfer.
Affected: M07, M08, M09, S3a, S3b, S4a, S4b, I06, O01.
Walk routes: R01, R04, R09. All circles are body centers,
not measured camera poses.

L02 / geometry prediction. Later capture each listed stance from both sides, include the follower, and inspect standing/crouched exposure plus all intermediate stair or ramp
positions. Roofs and slabs remain opaque. Movement openings and observation apertures are different contracts.
